requests.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the exact approved torchlit cave interior to edit. Images 2 and 3 are actual Paleolithic cave paintings: the Lascaux stag and Altamira hind, supplied ONLY as references for the painted animal's line, pigment handling, shape and relationship to stone.
Add ONE red-deer stag painting to the bare central wall of image 1, facing right, within approximately x29–84%, y24–45% of the full tall portrait. Leave the upper wall above y23% bare for a later step. This should look like accomplished Upper Paleolithic parietal art directly applied to the rock, with a distinct material language from the surrounding Ravilious-style illustrated cave. Draw from the economical bold Lascaux stag reference and the broad rusty ochre fields of Altamira, not a modern natural-history illustration.
The stag: one energetic, sweeping back-and-neck contour, a compact elongated body, small pointed muzzle, tiny simple dark eye mark, slender tapering legs rendered with a few spare strokes, and large asymmetric branching antlers spread in a legible fan. Express observation and movement with confident economy. Use strong irregular charcoal-dark contours that vary in pressure and thickness, some broken by the grain of the wall; thin reddish-brown ochre rubbed or dabbed over parts of the shoulder/body, with substantial unpainted stone remaining inside the silhouette. Pigment is dry, granular and matte, catching the wall's pits, not a smoothly shaded colored animal sticker. Let the existing stone bulge and seam contribute to the body's form. It is freshly made cave art, not artificially aged with new cracks.
The visible animal must be anatomically identifiable as a deer with coherent head, neck, body and four legs, but reduce internal detail to a few essential marks. No modeled musculature, fur rendering, glossy eye, eyelashes, elegant wildlife-poster finish, gradient shading, clean uniform vector outlines, decorative border or cartoon clumsiness. Skillful and powerful Paleolithic mark-making.
ABSOLUTELY preserve image 1's existing cave geometry, wall seam, ledge, torch and flame, lighting, all rock contours, floor, camera and framing. The only change is pigment applied flat to the central wall. No stars, dots, other animals, people, handprints, text, entrance or outdoor view yet. Preserve exact tall portrait proportions and all background colors. Do not copy the reference photographs' pale limestone background or other markings.
requests.notes: Paleolithic-style revision informed by actual Lascaux stag and Altamira hind photographs. Mineral pigment and economical contours replace modern wildlife illustration. Added pigment dots stand for stars in this fictional scene, without assigning known celestial meaning to actual archaeological signs.

Improve the Milky Way in the upper sky only: replace the current thin fairly uniform blue diagonal streak with a more authentic BROADER, softly feathered, irregular band of unresolved MILKY STAR CLOUDS, crossed by clearly legible branching DARK DUST LANES (the Great Rift). Study the supplied ESO photos: asymmetrical billowing star-density patches, gaps, forked charcoal dark lanes cutting through the glow, lumpy broad concentrations rather than a smooth narrow stripe. requests.compositionPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Recompose the FIRST supplied image, the approved deep-blue nighttime campfire watercolor, into a grander final resting scene. The two other images are scientific museum reconstructions used ONLY to inform unidealized early Homo sapiens appearance, NOT their poses, nudity, body paint, museum settings or photographic medium.
Preserve the approved image's Ravilious-inspired simplified watercolor and pencil texture, midnight indigo darkness, golden welcoming campfire glow and tiny distant torch glow deep in a cave. Tall portrait 854x1840 proportions. Move the campfire gathering DOWN to the VERTICAL CENTER of the entire canvas: fire centered x50%, y51%, the seated people around it extending roughly x27-73%,y48-59%. Keep five adults small in the landscape, exactly TWO women and THREE men, in practical irregular hide wraps, everyone clothed, sitting naturally and peacefully. Make their faces recognizably early Homo sapiens informed by museum reconstructions: individual broad/narrow facial variation, lived-in weathered faces, unstyled dark wavy or curly hair, medium to deep brown skin warmly lit, one older adult woman with greying hair and another adult woman at the sides of the group; varied ages and ordinary lean/robust physiques. Do not depict glamorous young models, identical smooth narrow faces, styled hairstyles or idealized white European storybook people. Do not make ape-like caricatures, hunched brutes or blend in diagnostic Neanderthal anatomy. Keep features simple at this small illustrative scale, with human dignity and warmth.
The upper HALF is now a vast dark night sky: many small stars, and a faint broad irregular Milky Way band with soft luminous blue-grey star clouds and darker branching dust lanes sweeping diagonally across it. This should quietly echo cosmic dust from the beginning of creation, suggest wonder and vastness, but look like the Milky Way seen by naked eye, not a close-up blazing nebula, not aurora, not a portal. Keep it darker than the fire, with NO MOON anywhere. Leave the stars open to view rather than filling the top with tree branches.
Low distant wooded hills and a winding river sit BELOW the sky around y40-48%; dry rocky terrace at center. The SAME modest irregular cave opening is farther back on the RIGHT at x80%,y44%, small and unobtrusive, unevenly dark with just one tiny warm torch far inside, no visible paintings at the entrance. People are well away from the cave. Lower area is an actual softly varied dark rocky terrace leading toward the group, unobtrusive stones/plant silhouettes near the edges; no huge empty flat grey field or designed blank panel. Keep enough low-contrast dark ground at the bottom for just two small game tokens, but this scene is primarily a complete composition of small humanity under a vast sky. No border, text, UI, buildings, modern objects, extra people or daytime light. Preserve the beautiful strong blue-night versus localized amber-fire contrast exactly.

requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ABSTRACT final painting for a game called Creation, portrait approximately1024x2208, full bleed with no blank playing area and no text. Anchor the composition CLOSELY in the supplied Pluscarden tapestry reference: several tall adjacent interwoven fields, deep blue vertical structure, irregular blocks of colour and intricate angular braided ribbons that travel through and across the fields. This is an original nonfigurative watercolour response to that textile, using Ravilious-like translucent washes, dry pencil hatching, layered paper texture and restrained sculpted colour planes. The painting should feel like a song or many voices interweaving, not an illustrated recap. Use indigo, cobalt, muted teal, moss green, ochre, rust-red and warm ivory; luminous pale threads catch against deeper colours. Four loosely defined vertical streams can suggest the reference's panel rhythm, but allow ribbons and colour fragments to cross between them; avoid black photograph gaps or literal wooden frames. Dense small passages alternate with broad calm translucent colour planes. Ambiguous traces and half-seen shapes may arise from the interweaving, but NOTHING should resolve into a clear depicted thing. No recognisable people, faces, animals, plants, mountains, sea, river, cave, fire, planet, stars, galaxies, Moon or landscape horizon. No vignettes, panels containing scenes, thumbnails of achievements or inventory objects. No literal musical notes, lettering, Hebrew text, runes, crosses, figures of gods, angels or other explicit religious symbols. Do not copy the reference's identifiable motifs or text. Let interwoven colour, rhythm, vertical movement, tension and luminous texture carry the emotion and scale. Hand-painted, irregular, quiet but powerful, not a glossy digital kaleidoscope or neat corporate vector pattern.
requests.notes: User-directed revision: nearly dark initial cave, restrained distant cave gathering, or abstract Pluscarden-inspired final painting. Supersedes the earlier selected candidate.
